summary: Matched electrophysiology and transcriptomes exist as neuronal Patch-seq data (DANDI:000020 CC-BY-4.0, 4,435 files; 44 GEO series mention Patch-seq, 9 also electrophysiology), and Allen's API gives 2,333 neurons' ephys features. All are spiking neurons, not slow developmental voltage patterns; no matched voltage-plus-proteome data were found and history dependence is not covered.
next_step: Pull one Patch-seq set with both reads and NWB ephys (DANDI:000020 and its transcriptome companion; verify location) and pre-register a prediction-versus-permutation test of resting/firing features from transcripts.
obstacles_confirmed: Matched live voltage and omics measurements exist for neurons only.
Proteins are not paired with voltage in the resources I checked.
